gist.summary: Simplified the PR news pipeline to keep one factual summary and one image prompt per PR. Updated social-post instructions to state selected price and access changes neutrally, with clear units and relevant effective dates. Restored public-content exclusions and fixed duplicate app links and recap counts. Validated with 15 tests and authenticated PR, daily, weekly, and one-day monthly A/B previews; no posts were published.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli wears tiny editor glasses and helps a friendly CRT monitor robot arrange one summary card and one picture card beside code-plants and a prominently lime green (#ecf874) desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and dark purple (#110518) details.
